conversations.name: Azure Function Migration from AWS Lambda

userMessage.content: I need to migrate an AWS Lambda function to Azure Functions. The Lambda uses the Node.js runtime and reads from an S3 bucket. What's the equivalent setup in Azure?

parts.value: Great! I'll use Azure Functions v4 with the Node.js runtime.
